question: In which year did India lift its first Cricket World Cup in the 50-over format?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2011**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• India lifted its first **Cricket World Cup** in the **50-over** format in the year **2011**. While India had famously won the World Cup earlier in **1983**, that tournament was played in a **60-over** per side format.
 
• The final of the **2011 ICC Cricket World Cup** was contested on **April 2, 2011**, at the **Wankhede Stadium** in **Mumbai**, **India**.
 
• The Indian team, captained by **Mahendra Singh Dhoni**, defeated **Sri Lanka** by **6 wickets** in the final. **Sri Lanka** batted first and set a target of **275 runs**, which India achieved by scoring **277/4** with **10 balls** remaining.
